item.infiniteinvo.unlock_slot.desc: Right-click to unlock one more extra slot. Sneak-right-click to open your inventory.
item.infiniteinvo.locked_slot.desc: Internal placeholder item used to reserve disabled slots.
infiniteinvo.configuration.title: InfiniteInvo Configuration
infiniteinvo.configuration.total_extra_s: Total slots managed by InfiniteInvo, excluding the hotbar. Client and server must use the same value.
infiniteinvo.configuration.start_unlocke: Number of slots unlocked for a new player.
infiniteinvo.configuration.require_exper: When disabled, every configured slot is available immediately.
infiniteinvo.configuration.unlock_cost.t: Cost of the next slot in levels, or experience points when raw experience mode is enabled.
infiniteinvo.configuration.unlock_cost_i: Additional cost for each slot unlocked after the initial allocation.
infiniteinvo.configuration.use_experienc: Charge raw experience points instead of experience levels.
infiniteinvo.configuration.keep_unlocks_: Keep unlocked slots when keepInventory is disabled.
infiniteinvo.configuration.remember_cont: Reopen ordinary containers on the most recently viewed extended inventory page.
infiniteinvo.configuration.locked_item_d: Ticks between locked-slot checks. One tick provides immediate cleanup.
